decision: Remove the full-path rehearsal gate, apply only the known mutable owner corrections, and immediately launch the single retained-claim capture owner.

permitted_preclaim_corrections: Accept both list and keyed-object bench collections in runtime/gpus.json.
Use the admission bench id at the atomic claim call; do not reference an undefined live_admission value.
Before claim, verify only compact source, packet, archive-member, checkpoint-manifest, tool, reservation, and bench identities. Do not reread or rehash checkpoint shards.
Accept this claim authority directly and persist the final owner source sha256 in the controller artifact root; do not require H200_EXACT_DIVERSE_CAPTURE_OWNER_READY.json.
Retrieve compact evidence from the guest to the controller in the correct direction before classification.

Keep the controller process and heartbeat live across a recoverable pre-science, launcher, observer, archive, or retrieval failure; expose a fresh repair handshake and do not leave an ownerless claim.
After a complete 32-request producer, preserve raw responses and capture bytes and repair only validation, retrieval, or the later consumer; never replay the producer.
Release only after a decision-bearing capture, unsafe or unreachable guest, or the absolute lifecycle handoff; otherwise retain the claim for repair.
forbidden_preclaim_work: Do not stream checkpoint shard hashes.
Do not simulate the complete detached lifecycle.
Do not execute the scientific request command.
Do not create another ready, audit, or command-seam terminal.
mutable_owner.disposition: Apply these bounded changes and continue directly into the detached claim in the same researcher run.

launch.active_session_contract: Immediately record detached-owner pid, start_ticks, absolute controller state path as unit, unit_manager pid, artifact root, bench id, and owner deadline in STATUS.json.active_session.
launch.first_execution: The first exact-runtime server and request path under this retained mutable claim is the discovery audit. Repair ordinary integration defects in place without another director gate.
